# Generation 6 — Chesed Possibility Field

The Awtsmoos renews every page from nothing, every route in light;
Awtsmoos.com should make every truthful public identity discoverable, bounded, and bright.

## Mission universe

- Complete the current clean release candidate before inventing another branch of work.
- Preserve the exact 47 authored-file transplant and 12 generated-artifact provenance proof.
- Mirror only intentionally ignored runtime corpus vessels required to reproduce real translation integrity.
- Re-run the clean candidate from the beginning after corpus parity is restored.
- Require clean static, SEO, Heichel, routes, tunnel release, syntax, XML, diff, and source-law gates.
- Boot the exact clean candidate on a fresh port.
- Run targeted public-family acceptance: home, Heichelos, apps, games, aliases, comments, translations, Torah Road, stable Road, missing Road.
- Run strict 120-URL crawl and complete discovered-graph crawl with zero errors and zero advisories.
- Measure transport retries separately from HTTP failures.
- Add canonical/schema parity and orphan checks only if they can be implemented without delaying a verified deployment.
- Fresh-fetch origin/main immediately before commit; stale lineage aborts.
- Stage exact tracked release scope only; ignored runtime corpus must remain unstaged.
- Run release prepare/dry-run through repository-native tooling.
- Commit and push exact release candidate.
- Prove remote main equals the pushed SHA.
- Activate production using exact-SHA guarded release flow.
- Verify production process/service/checkout evidence where the release tooling exposes it.
- Raw-public verify critical HTML, robots, XML MIME/parse, schema, canonical, index/noindex, and stable Road equality.
- Browser-shadow verify hydrated public UI after crawler-facing proof.
- Distinguish stale external search cache from direct origin truth.
- Write final evidence, planned-vs-actual, shadow-work, and remaining-work closure.

## Beyond-deploy future evolution

- Canonical parity engine across sitemap, HTML, OG, JSON-LD, and ordinary links.
- Orphan public-entity detector.
- Duplicate normalized-content detector.
- Canonical collision detector across dynamic families.
- Schema privacy key allowlists.
- Alias p50/p95/p99 SSR budgets.
- Comment reply graph integrity.
- Translation malformed/empty/duplicate-body quality analysis.
- Sitemap cardinality history and regression thresholds.
- Resumable deep crawler checkpoints.
- Public knowledge graph snapshots and internal health dashboard.
